# 🚀 Complete Go (Golang) End-to-End Learning Workspace

Welcome to your full Go mastery track materialized with **Trak**.

## 📚 Comprehensive Module Index

| Module | Title | Core Concepts |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-prerequisites` | **Setup & Environment** | Installation (Windows/macOS/Linux), GOPATH/GOROOT, VS Code tools, `go version` |
| `01-runtime-and-escape-analysis` | **Go Runtime & Memory** | TCMalloc allocator, Tri-Color GC, Stack vs Heap, `go build -gcflags="-m"` |
| `02-toolchain-and-workspaces` | **Toolchain & Modules** | `go mod`, `go work`, cross-compilation (`CGO_ENABLED=0`), `-race` detector |
| `03-variables-and-zero-values` | **Variables & Types** | Default zero values, short declarations, `iota` bitmask permissions |
| `04-data-types-and-memory-headers` | **Memory Layout** | String vs Slice memory headers (16B vs 24B), byte vs rune |
| `05-arrays-slices-and-growth` | **Slices Deep-Dive** | Dynamic growth, capacity doubling algorithm, sub-slice memory leaks & `copy()` |
| `06-maps-structs-and-custom-types` | **Maps & Structs** | Hash map concurrency safety, comma-ok idiom, struct embedding composition, JSON tags |
| `07-control-flow-and-functions` | **Control Flow** | For range variants, switch expressions, defer LIFO execution, panic & recover |
| `08-pointers-and-semantics` | **Pointers & Semantics** | Pass-by-value vs pointer semantics, memory mutation vs copying |
| `09-methods-interfaces-duck-typing` | **Interfaces** | Duck typing, `iface` vs `eface`, the infamous `(*Type)(nil) != nil` trap |
| `10-generics` | **Generics (Go 1.18+)** | Type parameters, `any`, `comparable`, custom type constraints |
| `11-error-handling-and-custom-types` | **Error Architecture** | Custom errors, `%w` wrapping, `errors.Is()`, `errors.As()`, sentinel errors |
| `12-concurrency-goroutines-gmp` | **Goroutines & GMP** | Goroutine vs OS threads, GMP model (`G`, `M`, `P`), cooperative scheduling |
| `13-channels-select-and-sync` | **Channels & Sync** | Buffered/unbuffered, select timeout, `sync.WaitGroup`, `Mutex`, `RWMutex`, `sync.Pool` |
| `14-context-cancellation-timeouts` | **Context Tree** | `WithCancel`, `WithTimeout`, `WithValue`, graceful cancellation cascades |
| `15-standard-library-powerhouses` | **Standard Library** | `io.Reader`/`io.Writer` streaming pipelines, `encoding/json`, OS signals |
| `16-production-web-services` | **Web Architecture** | `net/http`, middleware chains, structured JSON APIs, graceful shutdown |
| `17-database-sql-and-pooling` | **Database & Pooling** | `database/sql`, `SetMaxOpenConns`, `SetMaxIdleConns`, transactions, scanning |
| `18-testing-benchmarks-profiling` | **Testing & Profiling** | Table-driven tests, subtests `t.Run()`, benchmark `testing.B`, race detection |
| `19-interview-questions-and-drills` | **Interview Master Drill** | Top 10 high-yield interview questions with runnable code checks |

---

## 🛠️ How to Navigate & Run

Start at module 00 for environment setup:
```bash
cd 00-setup-and-prerequisites
go run main.go
```

# 00 - Go Setup & Installation Guide 🛠️

## 1. What is Go (Golang)?
Go is an open-source, compiled, statically typed language created at Google by Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike, and Ken Thompson. It is engineered for simplicity, high-performance network services, and multicore concurrency with lightweight goroutines.

---

## 2. Installing Go by Operating System

### 🪟 Windows
1. **Option A (Winget Package Manager - Recommended):**
   ```powershell
   winget install Golang.Go
   ```
2. **Option B (Installer MSI):**
   - Download the official `.msi` installer from: [https://go.dev/dl/](https://go.dev/dl/)
   - Run the installer and follow prompts.

---

### 🍎 macOS
1. **Option A (Homebrew - Recommended):**
   ```bash
   brew install go
   ```
2. **Option B (Official Package):**
   - Download the `.pkg` file for Apple Silicon (`arm64`) or Intel (`amd64`) from [https://go.dev/dl/](https://go.dev/dl/).

---

### 🐧 Linux (Ubuntu / Debian / RHEL / Arch)
1. **Option A (Official Binary Tarball - Recommended for Latest Version):**
   ```bash
   # Remove any previous Go installation and extract tarball to /usr/local
   sudo rm -rf /usr/local/go
   curl -OL https://go.dev/dl/go1.22.6.linux-amd64.tar.gz
   sudo tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.22.6.linux-amd64.tar.gz
   ```
   Add Go to your PATH in `~/.bashrc` or `~/.zshrc`:
   ```bash
   export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
   ```

---

## 3. Verifying Installation
Open a new terminal and run:
```bash
go version
go env
```

---

## 4. Recommended IDE Setup (VS Code)
1. Install **VS Code**.
2. Install the official **Go extension** (`golang.go`) from Google.
3. Open Command Palette (`Ctrl+Shift+P` / `Cmd+Shift+P`), type `Go: Install/Update Tools`, select all tools (`gopls`, `dlv`, `golangci-lint`), and press Enter.

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("=== 13: Channels & Sync ===")
	ch := make(chan string, 1)
	ch <- "Fast Message"
	select {
	case msg := <-ch:
		fmt.Println("Received:", msg)
	case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
		fmt.Println("Timed out")
	}

	var mu sync.RWMutex
	mu.Lock()
	fmt.Println("RWMutex locked for write")
	mu.Unlock()
}

# 19 - High-Yield Interview Questions & Quick Drills 🎯

### Top 5 Gotchas:
1. **GMP Scheduler**: Understand `G` (goroutine), `M` (OS thread), `P` (logical processor).
2. **`(*T)(nil) != nil`**: Why an interface with concrete type and nil value evaluates to `false` when checked with `== nil`.
3. **Map Concurrency**: Why maps panic on concurrent writes without mutexes.
4. **Defer Evaluation**: Parameters are evaluated immediately, but execution is deferred in LIFO order.
5. **Sub-slice Memory Leaks**: Large backing arrays pinned in memory by small slice windows.
